items.description: I have developed leadership experience at LEAD TECSUP, focused on team coordination, communication, organization, and collaboration. This role has strengthened my ability to support decision-making, guide teams, and contribute to smooth project and team coordination.

I represented and participated in activities of the Computer Society at TECSUP, contributing to teamwork, communication, and organization within the technology community. My involvement was centered on supporting collaboration and participation in activities related to technology and software development.

I contributed to frontend development using Astro and Tailwind CSS, working with REST APIs and implementing user-facing interfaces. I collaborated in a software development environment focused on problem solving, communication, and continuous improvement.

I am a Co-Founder & Software Developer at TIYUY, actively contributing to product development, technical decisions, and collaboration with the development team. This experience combines entrepreneurship and software development, with a focus on product vision, problem solving, and agile teamwork.

I currently work as a QA & Full Stack Developer, contributing to both frontend and backend development while focusing on software quality, testing, debugging, and reliable application delivery. My work combines full stack development, problem analysis, and continuous improvement of product stability and user experience.
